referenceSources.description:
A striking red Toyota MR-S GT300 car, numbered 34, races along a paved circuit. Bold BFGoodrich lettering spans the front bumper, while APEX and RAYS ENGINEERING logos adorn the hood and flanks. The car’s aerodynamic enhancements include a pronounced front splitter, side skirts, and a high-mounted rear wing.

This entry competed in the 2003 All-Japan Grand Touring Car Championship (JGTC) under the DENTAIRE PROJET RACING with apr banner. The metadata lists the MR-S 34 car alongside its driver lineup and team sponsors, situating it within the GT300 class of that season.
